fields.name: slug
fields.helperText: URL slug (must be unique). For future /authors/:slug pages.

fields.name: jobTitle
fields.helperText: Aligns with schema.org Person.jobTitle, e.g. "Licensed Veterinarian on the Dutch medical team"

fields.name: credentials
fields.helperText: Professional credentials (degree, board certs). First entry drives display name suffix.

fields.name: avatar
fields.helperText: Used at 36px in byline, 175px in About the Author strip.

fields.name: shortBio
fields.helperText: About the Author/Reviewer short bio displayed at the bottom of the article.

fields.name: sameAs
fields.helperText: External profile URLs (LinkedIn, ORCID, university page). Key E-E-A-T signal for schema.org Person.sameAs.

fields.name: linkType
fields.helperText: Where the byline name links to. Only 'Custom URL' is supported — set the URL in the Custom URL field below.

fields.name: customUrl
fields.helperText: The destination URL for the byline link. External (e.g. https://www.dutch.com/…) opens in a new tab; relative paths stay internal. If empty, the byline renders as plain text.
